description:
Join Atlas Air Worldwide. Move the World with Us! 

 At Atlas Air Worldwide, we’re not just an airline, we’re a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. As a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we’re built on a foundation of safety , service excellence , integrity , innovation , teamwork , and responsibility .  With over 30 years of history, a modern all-Boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we’re driven by purpose. 

 If you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here. 

 The Cloud Systems Engineer designs, engineers, automates, and continuously improves the enterprise cloud platforms and services that support Atlas Air’s business-critical airline operations, digital transformation initiatives, and data and AI capabilities. This is a hands-on engineering role for a technologist with a proven track record of building resilient, secure, and cost-optimized cloud environments at enterprise scale.

 Operating primarily in AWS, the Cloud Systems Engineer owns Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and platform engineering outcomes—not day-to-day manual provisioning. The role partners with cloud architects, security, DevOps, and application teams to modernize workloads, accelerate delivery, and raise engineering standards across the organization. The engineer serves as a subject matter expert and technical escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure challenges.

 Values and Behavioral Standards:  

 To ensure the effective communication and application of company values and behavioral standards, as stated in our company “Code of Conduct” policy, and to respond appropriately in the event of any known departure.

 Major Job Accountabilities (in priority order): 

 Platform Engineering & Automation 

 
 Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, including reusable modules, service templates, and enterprise guardrails.

 Develop and maintain CI/CD deployment pipelines using Git-based workflows (GitHub) to accelerate and standardize infrastructure and application delivery.

 Enable self-service infrastructure capabilities and automate operational processes to reduce toil and improve consistency and governance.

 Develop automation and tooling using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.

 
   Cloud Architecture & Engineering 

 
 Engineer AWS-based infrastructure supporting production, disaster recovery, and non-production environments.

 Translate business and application requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions.

 Design and implement disaster recovery and resiliency solutions across multiple Availability Zones and AWS Regions.

 Support enterprise data and AI platforms (e.g., Databricks, Amazon Bedrock) through robust cloud infrastructure engineering.

 Participate in solution architecture and design reviews; recommend improvements and evaluate emerging cloud services and technologies.

 
   Security & Compliance 

 
 Engineer solutions aligned with enterprise security standards and implement cloud-native security controls.

 Maintain least-privilege access principles across IAM and enforce network and data protection controls.

 Support audit, compliance, and vulnerability remediation initiatives.

 
 Cost Optimization (FinOps) 

 
 Analyze cloud consumption trends and identify optimization and rightsizing opportunities.

 Implement FinOps best practices and automation to reduce waste and support budgeting and forecasting.

 
 Operational Excellence & Support 

 
 Act as a technical escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure incidents and problems.

 Implement monitoring, observability, and alerting to ensure high availability and performance.

 Keep IT management apprised of critical issues, systemic problems, and risks in a timely manner.

 
 Collaboration, Documentation & Delivery 

 
 Partner with application teams to modernize workloads and improve deployment velocity.

 Champion high-quality documentation of technical processes, architectures, and runbooks that yield reproducible results.

 Lead knowledge-transfer activities and mentor junior engineers to raise overall team capability.

 Deliver assigned projects on time, within scope, and within budget, adhering to change control standards and coordinating internal and vendor resources.

 
 Required Qualifications:  

 
 Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in cloud, systems, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years designing and supporting enterprise cloud environments.

 Hands-on expertise with AWS delivering highly available, secure, and reliable services (e.g., IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, VPC, ECS/EKS).

 Proven experience implementing Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.

 Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub or equivalent Git-based workflows.

 Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar).

 Solid foundation in Linux and Windows administration, cloud networking, and IAM/security controls.

 Experience supporting production environments with high-availability and disaster recovery requirements.

 Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills; demonstrated results orientation, initiative, and ownership.

 Minimum 5+ years of Microsoft Windows Server environments

 Minimum 5+ Citrix Cloud Enterprise experience

 
 Desired Qualifications:  

 
 BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional (or equivalent).

 HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification.

 Experience with Kubernetes/EKS, serverless, and multi-account AWS environments.

 Experience supporting data/AI platforms (Databricks, Amazon Bedrock) or large-scale cloud migrations.

 Experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or other regulated industries.

 Experience mentoring engineers and comfort presenting to technical and non-technical audiences.

 
 Special Demands :

 This position may require travel on an as-needed basis to domestic and international company locations, data centers, and training events. The role participates in an on-call rotation and may be required to respond to major incidents outside of standard business hours.

  
 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship or employer immigration support either now or in the future.

 The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to afford equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, place of birth, age, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic or status protected by applicable in accordance with federal, state and local laws.

 If you'd like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please download the available EEO is the Law document by clicking " EEO Is The Law " .

 To view our Pay Transparency Statement, please click here: Pay Transparency Statement 

 Competitive compensation will be offered based on a variety of factors, including a candidate's experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity and other factors. In addition, a range of benefits to include medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, as well as generous paid time off, and 401K contributions are offered as a part of the total compensation package.

 Pay Range
 $136,500 — $185,000 USD 


 At  Atlas Air Worldwide , we believe in the power of people, the promise of innovation, and the responsibility we hold to each other, to our customers, and to the planet. Join us and be part of a team that lifts more than cargo; we lift ambition.
